answer_2.quote: We propose an automated intrinsic evaluation method to judge the quality of the set of questions ... by comparing this set with the set of questions actually asked to this candidate in a real interview. In forward evaluation, we compare each question q_j ∈ Q_i with questions in A_i ... In backward evaluation, we compare each question a_j ∈ A_i with questions in Q_i ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly assign one of these pairs to each of the N = 20 candidates... For each candidate, each human expert gave a comparative ranking, indicating whether set 1 was better than set 2.
answer_4.guideline: Human experts were asked to rank which of two generated question sets was better for each candidate.
